impact: Broad AI and growth selling hits MU, DRAM, SNXX, NBIS, PLTR and GOOGL/MSFT together; Oracle's 52-week low signals stress in AI infrastructure financing that matters for NBIS. The holiday-thin Friday session could amplify moves.
summary: US stocks fell hard on Wednesday, the last full session before Thanksgiving, after hotter-than-expected core PCE, the new tariff proposal and doubts about AI spending. At the close, the Nasdaq 100 tracker (QQQ) was down over 4%, the S&P 500 ETF almost 3% and the Dow ETF almost 2%, per Benzinga; the Nasdaq 100 briefly fell 20% below its record high intraday. Micron sank over 10%, AMD over 9% and Nvidia over 7%. Markets are shut Thursday and close early at 1 p.m. ET Friday.
title: Stocks tumble into Thanksgiving: Nasdaq 100 tracker down over 4% on hot PCE, tariffs and chip rout
